music.prompt: 29-second cinematic tech product launch score for a modern neurology clinic website. 120 BPM, D minor. Opens dark and spacious with a deep sub drone and delicate glassy digital sparkles (0-4s), a deep boom at 2s. At 4s a clean, straight 16th-note analog synth arpeggio sequence starts with deep half-time cinematic drums and a big reverb snare, warm sub bass and dark pads. Precise, futuristic, premium and confident like an Apple or Linear launch film. Builds from 17s with a snare roll and riser into a peak at 19s with four-on-the-floor drums until 23s. At 23s the drums drop out, a swell rises into a bright, glassy resolving chord at 24.5s, ending on a warm D major chord with a long tail. Instrumental only. No swing, no funk, no vocals.

boom.text: deep cinematic sub boom impact with a short dark tail
